[SWS_DM_00815] Triggering vehicle announcement messages
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04242
⌈
If
ara::diag::DoIPTriggerVehicleAnnouncement::TriggerVehicleAn-
nouncement
is called, the DM shall trigger vehicle announcement messages accord-
ing to ISO 13400-2[2] on the interface identified via
networkInterfaceId
.
⌋
